claims.statement: For every d>=1 and every genuine Boolean f:{-1,1}^n->{-1,1} of Fourier degree at most d, if v=1-fhat(empty)^2 then H(f)<=2(d-1)v+fhat(empty)^2 log2(1/fhat(empty)^2)<=(2(d-1)+log2(e))I(f). The first inequality is sharp for the degree-d address function.
claims.quantifiers: all integers n>=0, d>=1, and all genuine Boolean functions of Fourier degree at most d
known_inputs: Boolean Fourier granularity, Tal ECCC TR14-048 Fact 2.5
Boolean Bohnenblust-Hille support bound, Mathematische Annalen 2025 Lemma 4.1 and Proposition 4.2
limitations: does not extend to real or nearly Boolean degree-d functions
does not bound fixed-order Renyi entropy below one
